create_data_iterator: create a data iterator that reads JSON lines from files with distributed worker support
create_batch_iterator: create a batch iterator that groups examples into batches with optional shuffling and drop last
run_evaluation: run evaluation to compute accuracy by comparing predictions against ground truths using exact match
process_example: process an example dict to validate required query and target fields and add default passages
filter_results_by_id: filter retrieved passages by removing those with matching IDs from batch metadata to prevent cheating
